findings.description: The 'Returns' component of the description promises a field named `estimated_processing_days`, but the executor (line 91) actually returns the field `estimated_days`. The return-field list (component 2 of the 5 required description components) is inaccurate, so a caller that reads the description will look for a field that does not exist on the tool result.
findings.suggestion: Either rename the returned field to `estimated_processing_days` at line 91 to match the description, or update the description text on line 4 to list the field as `estimated_days` so the tool's advertised return shape matches its actual return shape.
